description: Underway for the signal controller bench: the boat really moves (about 790 m east over 4 minutes, matching the baseline's 3.3 m/s SOG), which is what signalk-autostate needs to leave 'moored' (it watches position, not speed: more than its distance threshold within its window). environment.mode is left alone for the whole run so the controller's DAY / NIGHT / RESTRICTED VISIBILITY buttons can be tried (the baseline otherwise rewrites it to day every second). Engines run, so autostate should settle on motoring.

after.note: stop rewriting environment.mode so a button press stays
